entries.claim: Rule 7 does not redact space-separated secret flags when the value is quoted. `value_run_end()` returns immediately on the opening quote, so inputs like `--token "tok-SECRET"` or `--token 'tok-SECRET'` fall through unchanged.
entries.failure_scenario: A CLI transcript or logged shell command containing a quoted secret flag value is emitted with the secret intact instead of `[redacted:a-command-line-flag-value]`.

entries.claim: `redact_url_userinfo()` rescans the remaining suffix from each `://` occurrence with `find`, so a line containing many ordinary URLs or URL-like fragments can become quadratic work.
entries.failure_scenario: A long prompt/log line with thousands of non-credential URLs causes the egress filter to spend superlinear CPU time just searching for userinfo, producing noticeable latency or a DoS vector.

counter_evidence.note: The loop ends `at = scan.max(start);` where `start = at + offset + SEP.len()` and `scan` only advances forward from `start`. `at` is therefore strictly monotonic and always past the `://` just consumed, so each `text[at..].find(SEP)` scans a region disjoint from every prior call. Total work is O(n), not quadratic - there is no rescan of an already-scanned suffix.

entries.claim: Rule 9 is pinned to a fixed GitHub token prefix list with no fallback or source of truth, so any token minted under a new GitHub prefix after the snapshot date is emitted unredacted.
entries.failure_scenario: When GitHub introduces a new prefix, e.g. a future `gh*_` family member not in the array, a pasted token with that prefix passes through the scrubber unchanged.

counter_evidence.note: The code states this in its own words: a PINNED list and a 2026-08-30 snapshot with no in-repo source of truth, which WILL go stale until someone edits the array, and a generic `gh?_` shape was rejected because it matches unrelated text. The pinned list is this phase CONTEXT decision D-10, and the generic-shape alternative the finding implies is the one that decision rejected. A locked decision restated back is an approach difference, not a defect.
